name: cal-04-date1
version_tag: CALENDAR (shiura 7035937 Ver.2) — units-of-date drum + white numeral inlay, FULL SIZE. Solo plate only because its natural partner, date10, was consumed as the cal-02 proof print; if that plate is ever reprinted, pair the two (bands overlap at 1.28-9.68 and 1.63-9.63, so one flush serves both and saves ~14g). REGISTRATION measured from original STL bbox centres: letter delta [-0.001, 0.000] — concentric — and base min-z -11.10 vs letter min-z -9.82 gives z_offset 1.276. Expect the two-colour band to start near layer 6 and run ~42 layers; a band starting at layer 0 means the offset was silently dropped. SPEEDS: stock 0.20mm Standard. FILAMENT: slot 1 black PLA MATTE, slot 2 white PLA BASIC, ams_mapping 2,0 — verify by eye, only the first filament is AMS-checked.
